name: effect-circle-mask-reveal
title: SVG Mask Reveal
description: Nội dung đứng yên, một mặt nạ tròn mở rộng từ một điểm gần góc trái để lộ dần toàn bộ.

moworks.author: takayu

options.radius: px, enough to clear the far corner (950)
options.exitAt: s after the start to close in 0.35 s (null)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio svg-mask-reveal, written here): Element stays still; a circle clip centred at about 16 % x / 58 % y of the element grows radius 0 -> 190 px (enough to clear the far corner) over 980 ms easeOutCubic (demo: 1.6 s ease-in-out); optional thin dashed guide ring. Exit: radius back to 0 over 350 ms ease-in. Params: x, y: tâm (16 % / 58 %) · radius (190 px) · duration (0.98 s) · ease (power2.out).
moworks.titleVi: Mặt nạ tròn mở lộ nội dung
